Title: Data Architect (Hands-On Builder) Location: Mexico Remote Data Architect will focus on the design, build, and evolve a modern, scalable data architecture that will power analytics, reporting, AI/ML use cases, and operational decision-making across the GTM business. This role will define data patterns and standards, partner with IT, and business partner teams to ensure our data platform is secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and easy to use. This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on architecture depth and can define target-state architecture, guide implementation, and ensure high-quality delivery across pipelines, integrations, and governance. Key Responsibilities Build and Own Core Data Pipelines (Hands-On) Architect and implement end-to-end ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems into Snowflake. Develop robust ELT/ETL workflows using dbt and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow/Dagster/ADF), including: incremental loads, SCD handling, backfills, and reprocessing late-arriving data patterns and idempotent job design CDC-based ingestion where applicable Build integrations for key enterprise SaaS systems (Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, Netsuite, Zuora, Gainsight, CSOD) and internal app databases. Data Modeling & dbt Development Own the data modeling layer in Snowflake with dbt: design dimensional models (star schemas), marts, and curated layers implement dbt best practices: staging → intermediate → marts, modular models, macros, packages define metric-ready datasets (e.g., ARR/NRR, pipeline, churn, product usage) with consistent definitions Optimize for performance and cost (clustering, warehouse sizing, query patterns, caching, micro-partitioning awareness). Cloud Platform Enablement (AWS + Azure) Implement secure, scalable data platform components across AWS and Azure: landing zones, storage (S3/ADLS), networking, secrets management, and compute integration patterns secure connectivity to Snowflake (PrivateLink/peering patterns where relevant) Work with technology teams to implement RBAC, role hierarchy, masking policies, row access policies, and data sharing patterns. Reliability, Testing, and Observability Implement data quality and reliability controls: dbt tests (schema, relationship, accepted values) and custom tests for business logic anomaly detection and pipeline monitoring (e.g., Datadog/CloudWatch/Azure Monitor, Monte Carlo if applicable) SLAs/SLOs for critical datasets and clear incident runbooks Build operational readiness: logging, alerting, retries, failure isolation, and safe deploys. CI/CD, Version Control, and Engineering Practices Build and maintain CI/CD for data development (PR checks, dbt builds, environment promotion). Establish practical engineering standards: naming conventions, repo structure, branching strategy documentation that stays current (dbt docs, data dictionaries) code reviews and design patterns that scale with the team AI / Agentic AI Architecture Design and implement architecture patterns that support AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic AI use cases across the Sales business, including structured and unstructured data pipelines, retrieval-ready data design, and secure enterprise data access. Define scalable patterns for AI-enabled applications and agents, including metadata design, indexing, vector-ready data preparation, API/tool access, and governance controls such as lineage, auditability, observability, and guardrails. Partner Closely with Analytics & Business Teams Collaborate with BI/Analytics to ensure the curated layer supports dashboards and self-service. Translate business needs into data products quickly with tight feedback loops, iterative delivery, measurable outcomes. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture with a strong hands-on track record. Strong production experience with Snowflake (performance tuning, data loading patterns, security model). Strong production experience with dbt: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, documentation, deployments Experience building pipelines and integrations in AWS and/or Azure (both preferred). Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, SCD types). Experience with orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Azure Data Factory) and reliable job design. Strong understanding & framework implementation of data quality, monitoring, and operational best practices. Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have) Experience with ingestion tooling (Boomi, Fivetran, Matillion, Informatica, Stitch) and/or CDC tooling (Debezium/HVR). Experience designing or supporting data architecture for GenAI, RAG, enterprise search, or agentic AI use cases in production environments. Familiarity with modern AI-related technologies and patterns such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain/LangGraph, Snowflake Cortex, Azure AI services, vector-ready data pipelines, and secure tool integration for AI agents. Experience with streaming/event ingestion (Kafka/Kinesis/Event Hubs) for near-real-time pipelines. Familiarity with governance/security patterns in Snowflake (masking/row access, tags, classification). Exposure to BI layers (Tableau/Power BI/Looker) and semantic/metrics frameworks. Python experience for custom integrations, APIs, and automation (Lambda, Azure Functions). CA-DNP Our commitment to you! BMC’s culture is built around its people. Description: Do you enjoy leading complex health actuarial projects while still being hands‑on with models and analytics? Are you motivated by coaching actuarial talent and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders? Join Aon’s Global Capability Center and help shape best‑in‑class health actuarial solutions for clients around the world! This is a hybrid role based in Mexico City , with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Mexico City office, in line with Aon’s Smart Working policy. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like You will be a senior technical leader within Aon’s Global Capability Center in Mexico City, acting as a bridge between individual contributor and people leader roles. You will lead complex health actuarial analyses, coordinate project delivery, and provide day‑to‑day oversight and coaching for a small team of actuarial professionals, while maintaining a significant hands‑on technical contribution. On a Typical Day, You Will Lead the most complex health actuarial modeling and analysis assignments (IBNR and reserve studies, pricing and rate development, actuarial value and funding evaluations, experience and trend analyses, budgets and projections). Serve as technical reviewer and subject matter expert, ensuring consistency and quality across models, assumptions and deliverables. Develop work plans, assign tasks and monitor progress across your team and other Actuarial Team Managers on large or complex projects. Review models, exhibits and analyses prepared by team members, providing structured feedback and ensuring compliance with actuarial standards, documentation requirements and internal controls. Drive process improvement and automation initiatives, contributing to reusable tools, templates and model libraries. Provide ongoing technical coaching, support onboarding and training, lead knowledge‑sharing sessions and act as a role model for technical excellence and professional conduct. Collaborate with Health & Benefits consulting teams, actuaries and operational partners across North America and other regions, presenting methodologies, assumptions and results to internal stakeholders and supporting client‑facing teams during renewals, RFPs, pricing studies and strategic projects. How this opportunity is different Responsibilities This role offers the opportunity to combine deep technical actuarial work with leadership and coordination responsibilities in a global consulting environment. You will: Operate at the intersection of technical expertise and people leadership, guiding complex actuarial projects while coaching and developing analysts and senior analysts. Work as part of Aon’s Global Capability Center, collaborating daily with Health & Benefits teams and actuaries across North America and other regions. Influence methodologies, tools and processes used across multiple client engagements, helping to standardize and improve how Aon delivers health actuarial work globally. Grow your leadership profile in a setting that values both technical depth and the ability to manage workstreams and people, creating a strong platform for future actuarial management or consulting roles. Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success Undergraduate degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or another quantitative field, with 7+ years of experience in health actuarial work (insurance, employee benefits consulting or related disciplines). Proven track record leading complex actuarial projects or workstreams, coordinating and reviewing the work of other actuarial professionals, and mentoring/developing junior colleagues in global, cross‑functional environments. Expert proficiency in Excel and health actuarial modeling (IBNR/reserving, pricing and rate development, funding/contribution strategies, forecasting and projection models), with strong ability to validate, reconcile and interpret complex datasets. Significant progress toward professional actuarial credentials (SOA, IFOA, CONAC or equivalent) and demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and knowledge‑sharing. Recognized as a trusted technical leader who drives process excellence, automation and innovation, and who communicates effectively with stakeholders while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic consulting environment. 2585535

Acerca del rol El Retail Development Kiosk existe para garantizar la excelencia operativa y comercial en la red de tiendas de PayJoy México. Este rol es crítico para proteger la rentabilidad del negocio mediante el control riguroso de inventarios, precios, materiales promocionales y métricas de riesgo crediticio (FPD) en cada punto de venta. Al asegurar la consistencia en la ejecución de los KPIs clave, esta posición reduce la variabilidad entre tiendas, previene pérdidas por desbalances de inventario o precios incorrectos, y proporciona visibilidad oportuna para detectar y corregir desviaciones antes de que impacten el negocio. El candidato ideal combina habilidades analíticas sólidas con capacidad de trabajo en campo y comunicación efectiva con equipos de tienda. Responsabilidades Clave Control de inventario en tienda: Monitorear y auditar de manera regular los niveles de inventario de equipos celulares en cada punto de venta, identificando situaciones de sobrestock o desabasto, y coordinando acciones correctivas con los equipos de supply chain y operaciones para mantener niveles óptimos que soporten las metas de venta sin generar capital inmovilizado. Supervisión de precios de equipos: Verificar que los precios de los equipos celulares en tienda sean consistentes con la política comercial vigente, detectando y escalando discrepancias que puedan erosionar márgenes o generar confusión en el cliente, asegurando una ejecución correcta de actualizaciones de precios en todos los puntos de venta de la red. Gestión de materiales y activaciones promocionales: Asegurar que las tiendas cuenten con los materiales promocionales correctos y actualizados (POP, señalética, fichas de producto), coordinando su distribución oportuna y verificando en campo que las promociones vigentes estén correctamente exhibidas y comunicadas al equipo de ventas para garantizar una ejecución impecable en el piso. Seguimiento y control de métricas FPD/Riesgo: Recopilar, analizar y reportar los indicadores de First Payment Default (FPD) y otras métricas de riesgo crediticio por tienda, identificando patrones o tiendas con comportamiento atípico, y colaborando con los equipos de riesgo y operaciones para implementar acciones correctivas que mejoren la calidad de la cartera originada en punto de venta. Monitoreo del cumplimiento de KPIs por tienda: Dar seguimiento periódico a los KPIs comerciales y operativos clave de cada tienda (conversión, ticket promedio, colocación, inventario, cumplimiento de precios, entre otros), generando reportes de desempeño que permitan identificar brechas, reconocer mejores prácticas y proponer planes de acción para elevar el estándar de ejecución en toda la red. Generación de reportes e insights accionables: Consolidar la información de inventario, precios, promociones, FPD y KPIs en dashboards o reportes ejecutivos periódicos dirigidos a la gerencia comercial y de operaciones, facilitando la toma de decisiones oportuna y el seguimiento de iniciativas de mejora a nivel red de tiendas. Colaboración transversal con equipos internos: Actuar como enlace entre los equipos de tienda, supply chain, marketing, riesgo y finanzas para asegurar que los procesos comerciales y operativos se ejecuten de manera coordinada, resolviendo blockers operativos y escalando oportunamente situaciones que requieran atención de otras áreas del negocio. Experiencia: 2 años de experiencia en roles de operaciones, control de inventarios, auditoría de proyectos o análisis de KPIs operativos/financieros. Dominio de herramientas de análisis de datos: Nivel intermedio en Excel o Google Sheets (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas). Capacidad de interpretar y presentar datos de manera clara. Idioma: Español nativo; Inglés nivel básico-intermedio (capacidad de leer reportes y comunicarse por escrito con equipos regionales) Disponibilidad para trabajo de campo: Disposición para realizar visitas a tiendas en la zona asignada dentro de México, con posibilidad de viajes ocasionales a nivel nacional.
